items.title: US stocks with the highest debt-to-equity ratios: Birkenstock and peers
items.summary: Investing.com -- The US market’s highest-leverage names are posting debt-to-equity ratios from 1,000% to over 15,000%, with some carrying more debt than their entire market cap and holding less than 5% of capital in cash. That’s not just aggressive — it’s financial brinkmanship, and it puts these stocks in a league with Energizer and Birkenstock for capital structure risk.
